_comment: Frozen grammar for searching a room's messages (GET /rooms/{room}/messages/search, `mycelium room search`). The backend owns the grammar (fastapi-backend/app/services/message_search.py over facet_query.py); the CLI carries a copy (mycelium-cli/src/mycelium/search_grammar.py) that cli_prose uses to check every search query written in the docs, skills, prompts and frontend strings. A unit test on each side asserts against this file, so a field can't be documented that the hub does not answer.
